evaluation_standard: Identical physical, physiological and thermodynamic constraints (Body mass = 80kg, TARGET-FORCE20 = +20% whole-body force, TARGET-CPE45 = 2700s continuous repeated bouts)

Architecture_A.name: Native Biological Enhancement
Architecture_A.description: Hypertrophy, fiber-type optimization, neural drive tuning, metabolic buffering, and targeted connective tissue reinforcement within native anatomical structures.

metrics.cpe45_viability: CONDITIONAL_POTENTIAL (Requires active cooling and adequate hydration)
metrics.experimental_analogs: Elite powerlifters, sprint athletes, myostatin-null phenotype (human & Belgian Blue)
metrics.verdict: PRIMARY_RECOMMENDED_DIRECTION (Physiologically coherent, zero compartment syndrome, natural neural control, but bottlenecked by tendon kinetics and thermal dissipation)

Architecture_B.name: Supplemental Bioengineered Muscle
Architecture_B.description: Surgically implanted autologous or tissue-engineered muscle fascicles arranged in parallel with native musculature.

max_useful_force.value: +5% to +15% (degraded by poor moment arm and insertion angles)

tendon_path_restriction.stress_increase: Severe shear stress at periosteal / tendon junctions

mass_and_volume.compartment_syndrome_risk: CRITICAL_FATAL (Causes acute myofascial compartment syndrome; intrafascial pressure > 45 mmHg)

oxygen_and_nutrition.perfusion_status: CENTRAL_ISCHEMIC_NECROSIS in grafts > 5 mm thickness without microvascular anastomosis

energy_budget.substrate: Depletes systemic glucose; causes massive lactic acid release into host circulation

heat_dissipation.metabolic_heat_W: Deep tissue heat generation without adequate venous heat clearing

metrics.cpe45_viability: NO_GO (Causes ischemic contracture and systemic toxicity within minutes)
metrics.experimental_analogs: VML tissue engineered muscle patches in rodent/porcine defect repair (restores ~30-50% lost defect mass, never augments healthy baseline)
metrics.verdict: DISQUALIFIED_NO_GO (Fundamentally unviable due to compartment syndrome, vascular necrosis, lack of proprioception, and anchor shear)

Architecture_C.name: Internal Biohybrid Actuation
Architecture_C.description: Internal implantable electroactive polymer, hydraulic, or motor-driven artificial actuators anchored to the skeleton.

tendon_path_restriction.rupture_risk: Aseptic loosening, bone resorption, fatigue fracture under cyclic load

mass_and_volume.compartment_syndrome_risk: EXTREME (Requires extensive bone/muscle resection to create cavity)

oxygen_and_nutrition.tissue_risk: Compression of adjacent vessels; thermal coagulation of adjacent tissue

heat_dissipation.result: FATAL_INTERNAL_THERMAL_NECROSIS without active fluid cooling to external environment

metrics.cpe45_viability: NO_GO (Thermal accumulation in closed human cavity exceeds safe tissue limit in < 10 minutes)
metrics.experimental_analogs: Left ventricular assist devices (LVAD), osseointegrated robotic amputee prostheses (external limb replacement)
metrics.verdict: BREAKTHROUGH_DEPENDENT_HOLD (Impossible inside intact human limbs due to internal heat rejection, battery mass, bone anchor fatigue, and lack of internal cavity; viable only as external exoskeleton or total joint replacement)

decision_summary.held_architecture: Architecture C (Internal Biohybrid Actuation) — HOLD / BREAKTHROUGH-DEPENDENT (Unviable for intact human internal augmentation)
